title: Men's Gym – Squire, Spot Me Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the lifter who treats every bench day like a quest and needs a squire to spot him, zipped on for the warm-up and the walk back to the castle.
art: A knight in full armor with a red plume lies on a bench pressing a loaded barbell while a nervous young squire in a tunic spots him, in cream, red, blue and gold with a worn print texture.
headline: SQUIRE,
inks: coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash
chest: a small knight helmet with a barbell behind it
warm2: cold garage gyms, early warm-ups and the drive home
gift_line: for the gym friend who never lifts without a spotter and a good excuse.
seo_desc: A knight zip up hoodie: SQUIRE, SPOT ME on the back over a knight bench pressing with a squire, plus an embroidered helmet and barbell on the chest.
